About.metaDescription: Learn about Al Hafiz Nur Al-Madinah — a premium retailer of Arabic perfumes, dates, and Middle Eastern goods in Puncak Alam, Selangor.
About.title: About Al Hafiz Nur Al-Madinah
About.subtitle: A premium retail store bringing the authenticity of the Middle East to Eco Grandeur, Puncak Alam.
About.story1: Al Hafiz Nur Al-Madinah was founded to bring authentic Middle Eastern goods closer to the Malaysian community — from long-lasting Arabic perfumes and hand-selected dates to specialty foods and everyday Islamic essentials.
About.story2: Every item on our shelves is sourced directly from trusted suppliers and curated for quality, so each visit feels like a trip to the markets of Madinah and beyond.
